stale.body: This document is out of date with your exercise edits. Rebuilding replaces it with the exercises — including any changes you made here.

image.replaceDeferred: Replacing an image with your own arrives with image rendering, in the next update.

confirm.allBody: This plans a fresh set of exercises and replaces every one on the sheet.
confirm.allEditedBody: Some exercises carry your edits. Regenerating plans a fresh set and replaces the whole sheet — your edits will be lost.
confirm.cardEditedBody: This exercise carries your edits. Regenerating replaces its content — your edits will be lost.
confirm.documentEditedBody: You’ve made changes in the worksheet document. Continuing rebuilds the worksheet from the exercise cards and replaces the whole document — including any formatting or edits you made there. This can’t be undone.
confirm.rebuildBody: Your exercise edit is saved either way. Rebuilding updates the document to match your exercises, but replaces any changes you made in the document itself. Keep your document to leave it untouched — it will be out of date with the exercises until you rebuild.

partial.carryOn: You can keep working; the rest can be regenerated.
